cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

# rvv_bench_kb: parallel Zephyr app for KernelBench problems using PyTorch
# goldens for correctness. ExecuTorch is NOT linked here — the baseline cycle
# count is precomputed at extraction time and baked into src/data.h.
# Selected by saturn_eval when prob_type starts with "kb-rvv".
#
# Per-problem files (src/data.h, src/params.c) are generated by
# scripts/extract_kb_problem.py. main.c is overwritten on every build by
# saturn_eval with the harness + injected candidate code.

set(CONF_FILE prj.conf riscv_vector.conf)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(rvv_bench_kb)

target_include_directories(app PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)

target_sources(app PRIVATE
  src/main.c
  src/params.c
)

target_compile_options(app PRIVATE
  -march=rv64gcv
  -O3
  -ftree-vectorize
)
